बॉस, नितेश तिवारी की फिल्म Ramayana सिर्फ मुख्य सितारों की ही नहीं, बल्कि हर एक सपोर्टिंग किरदार की शानदार अदाकारी की वजह से जबरदस्त चर्चा में है! 🎬

फिल्म में रणबीर कपूर, साई पल्लवी और यश तो मुख्य किरदारों में हैं ही, पर सपोर्टिंग कास्ट ने भी खूब ध्यान खींचा है। 1987 के टीवी शो में राम बने अरुण गोविल अब राजा दशरथ के भावुक किरदार में नजर आ रहे हैं, वहीं लारा दत्ता रानी कैकेयी के रूप में दिखाई दी हैं।

इंदिरा कृष्णन ने कौशल्या और सौरभ सचदेवा ने मारीच के रूप में दमदार छाप छोड़ी है। शोभना ने रावण की मां कैकसी और रकुल प्रीत सिंह ने शूर्पणखा के रोल में बदले की आग को दिखाया है। इसके साथ ही विवेक ओबेरॉय ने विद्युतजीव का रोल निभाया है, जबकि काजल अग्रवाल का मंदोदरी का रोल पार्ट 2 में बड़ा होने की उम्मीद है। 🔥⭐

आपके मुताबिक Ramayana के इस शानदार कास्टिंग में किस एक्टर की परफॉर्मेंस ने आपका दिल जीत लिया? कमेंट्स में हमें जरूर बताएं! 👇

#Ramayana #RanbirKapoor #NiteshTiwari #ArunGovil #LaraDutta #RakulPreetSingh #CineChaska

ctx.title: Ramayana Characters’ Review: Anupam Kher’s Jatayu, Ravie Dubey’s Lakshman & Sharad Kelkar’s Ravana Rule, But Sunny Deol Had Me In Only 3 Seconds! [Opinion]
ctx.summary:
Apart from Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Yash, Ramayana's characters and their casting is so on point that you need to discuss them - an opinion! 
 The post  Ramayana Characters’ Review: Anupam Kher’s Jatayu, Ravie Dubey’s Lakshman & Sharad Kelkar’s Ravana Rule, But Sunny Deol Had Me In Only 3 Seconds! [Opinion]  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Ever since Nitesh Tiwari’s Ramayana arrived in the theaters, everyone has been talking about the big three: Yash as Ravana, Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Ram, and Sai Pallavi as Devi Sita. But an epic like this also lives in its characters: the king who must choose his vow, the queen who falls for a trap, the prince who follows the duties of a brother, the vulture who dies for friendship.
The scale and casting of this grand film is its biggest USP. The true triumph of this mythological milestone lies far beyond its primary trio. Casting director Mukesh Chhabra and Nitesh Tiwari have constructed an ensemble so meticulously detailed that no character looks secondary and even with a minute appearance leaves a strong imprint. From emotional voice performances to high-octane cameos, the cast elevates the film from a standard big-budget spectacle into a cinematic celebration!
Here is a detailed breakdown of the standout character performances that drive the emotional heart of Ramayana, led by Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, Ravie Dubey, and Yash at the center! But Nitesh Tiwari assembled the most pitch-perfect mythological ensemble in Modern Hindi Cinema! Here’s a breakdown of the characters of the Ramayana!
Arun Govil played Lord Ram in the 1987 TV serial by Ramanand Sagar! He was worshipped as Lord Ram by the audience and was introduced to this generation yet again during the COVID phase! So seeing him as the father of the very character he ruled with on the small screen was surreal! The king who must send Ram away has a quiet beauty. The film made brilliant use of Arun Govil’s on-screen history! In one of the scenes, he asks Ram to kill him, and he makes an impact! Especially in his final moments and his last call for his beloved son Ram!
A post shared by The World Of Ramayana (@worldoframayana)
The most divisive Ayodhya character. Lara Dutta honestly does not convince much as the shrewd Queen Kaikeyi. But she does win with her emotional restraint when she gives a final farewell to Ram, Lakshman, and Sita before they leave Ayodhya! You never hate Kaikeyi in this version of the Ramayana, and that probably is a miss by Lara!
A post shared by The World Of Ramayana (@worldoframayana)
The eldest queen of Ayodhya is played by Indira Krishnan! She provides a serene matriarchal presence as Lord Ram’s mother. Her quiet and dignified grief during the palace departure scenes and her immense celebration before Ram’s coronation stay with the audience!
A post shared by Indira Krishna (@indirakrishna101)
She’s one of Hindi cinema’s most reliable character actors, and Manthara is the kind of role she can make memorable in a few scenes. She brings a sly, atmospheric intensity to Manthara. Her quiet whisperings and manipulative dialogues with Kaikeyi trigger the central conflict of this epic effectively.
A post shared by Saurabh Sachdeva (@saurabhsachdeva77)
The film’s boldest addition is Ravana’s mother. Shobhana has a powerful presence. She is critical to the story of Ravana’s origin as one of the greediest demon kings who lost everything due to lust and greed! Shobhana’s Kaikasi takes us to the backstory of Ravana and how his greed is also fuelled by the daughter of the king of demons, Sumali!
A post shared by Shobana Chandrakumar (@shobana_danseuse)
Vivek Oberoi’s Vidyutjeeva was an on-point opportunity! Playing the husband of Shurpanakha and Ravana’s friend, Vidyutjeeva’s jealousy towards Kumbhkarna is channeled brilliantly by Vivek Oberoi! However, the episode was unnecessary and a bit dragged when weighed in the bigger scheme of events!
There has been a lot of criticism around Rakul Preet Singh’s Shurpanakha being too dramatic and theatrical. But in my opinion, she is the perfect antagonist this epic could have! She plays Shurpanakha to perfection, fueled by anger to seek revenge! A revenge that had a huge cost!
